Kenichi ed alcuni compagne si recano a scuola durante le vacanze estive per visitare il club di archeologia dove è stato consegnato un antico manufatto recentemente scoperto, uno specchio dall’aspetto bizzarro.
Improvvisamente però dal manufatto si sprigiona una violenta luce che investe i presenti facendogli perdere conoscenza.
Kenici si risveglia presso la piscina, stordito ed inconsapevole di come ci sia arrivato; è solo, non sa cosa sia accaduto ai suoi amici ed ha il vago ricordo di aver sognato di aver fatto sesso con l’amica MIho. Superato il primo stupore di vivere la carnalità di un corpo che non gli appartiene, Kenichi, l’amica Yohimi, l’amica d’infanzia Miho e la kohai Sakajou, continueranno a scambiare i propri corpi e condizionati dal misterioso specchio, vivranno esperienze sessuali rese ancor più coinvolgenti perché vissute in un corpo non proprio o opposto al proprio sesso.

Minacciati dalla barriera che potrebbe presto far scomparire la dimensione parallela in cui sono imprigionati, i ragazzi devono trovare una via d’uscita per tornare nel mondo normale.

※アップデート・修正一覧※
ver1.03の変更点
修正/「回想部屋」に存在するクリスタルに特定の向きでアクションを起こすと色がおかしくなるバグを修正。
修正/特定のHシーンにて、Hシーン後もBGSが鳴り続けてしまうバグを修正。

追加機能/一度見たことのある夜伽のスキップ機能を追加致しました。
(このスキップした場合でも、各種パラメータとお金は入手することが可能です)

―――――――――――――――――――――――――
▼物語▼
彷徨える魂を浄化し、あの世へ還すことを生業とする『封術師』
小さな村にも、その封術師を生業とする少女が一人いた。
その名は『たまも』

彼女は魂を浄化した際に残る「霊子」を集め「転生桜」と呼ばれる
桜を満開にすることを目的としていた。
しかし、魂を浄化する際に用いる「封札」には「生命力」が必要。
その生命力を集める為に、日々『夜伽』をこなすのだった。


▼ゲームシステム▼
・煩わしい戦闘は一切なし!

『封札』というアイテムを持って彷徨える魂に接触すると、魂は浄化されます。
難しい戦闘などはありませんので、そういったRPGが苦手な方でも大丈夫です!


▼Hイベント▼
・Hイベント全17種

基本的には夜伽をこなすことでHシーンが増えていきます。
中には夜伽をすることで増えていくパラメータによって
村の人に話しかけると発生するイベントも……。
また、回想部屋が最初から解放してあるので、
一度見たHシーンはいつでも見ることができます!
(回想部屋は、自宅の右側の階段にあります)


▼Hシーンの種類▼
・ダブル手コキ
・フェラ
・騎乗位
・輪姦
・乱交
・触手H
・なめくじH
・竜とH


▼体験版▼
体験版はある程度の夜伽まで見ることができます。
それ以外は製品版で出来ることとほぼ変わりませんので、
ご興味を持って頂けましたら是非体験版をプレイして
いただければと思います!

※体験版にて、「たまもの家」の右側に存在する「回想部屋」に入れないバグを修正


___________________________________________


* Story *
There is a girl named Tamamo living in a village.
She is a Seal Master... that specializes in sending wandering
spirits to their rightful place in the realms beyond...

There's just one catch... the ingredients that Tamamo needs
to make her special sealing items is... 'Life Force'... Yes. That's right.

White, warm, sticky and smelly... 'Life Force'.

* Game System *
No annoying battles at all!

Use an sealing item to send wandering spirits to the realms beyond.
No difficult battles or anything so those that don't like RPGs can enjoy!

Any H scene you have witnessed before is skip-able.

* H events *
17 types of events implemented.
The more you perform them, the more become available.
Parameters change and there are events that are triggered by
merely talking to the villagers. (Reminiscence mode implemented)

* Situations *
Double handjob, fellatio, cowgirl style,
gangbang, orgy, tentacle H, slug H, dragon H.

Introduction of R-18 Game "Defence Agent Gaya"

[Main Story]
Agent Gaya of Defence Section 9 dressed up like a magician,
sneaks into a city parasited by alien tentacle monsters.

Facing the enemy with Hig IQ and also good at disguising.
Gaya has to exchange her body for intelligence to complete the mission.
Miraculous special ability related with light!
Custom tailored tights that will become transparent in special situations!
Mysterious 3 men in black! A lot of hard tests are waiting for the heroine.

* No Battle Scenes, No Complicate Mazes. A Compact Story
Exploratory RPG, with sound instruction system.

Total clear time: About 2 hours.
Created with RPGMaker VX Ace
The total size of the game is about 90MB / about 50000 words.
Screen size 640x480.

* Requires RPG TKool VX Ace RTP (free):
https://tkool.jp/support/download/rpgvxace/rtp

* 20 independent H scenes with CGs,
Each CG has at least 3 variations.
The scenes are tightly linked by the story.
* 50% inter-species, tentacle, machine & vore content
* 50% not inter-species, sleeping, magic, giant content
* Does not contain any extremely bloody pictures.

[Game Features]
1: Interactive lightning effects, you can take kinds of light-items.
2: Rhythmical H scene BGMs and rich sound effects.
3: H scene dialogues descriptive and detailed.
4: Rule of driving a car in city & parking rules.
5: You can take a map of the whole city with you.
6: Other... countless interesting setups.

The old emperor made a declaration.
Whoever could make Catherine the queen pregnant first, would win the throne.

The best candidate, Prince Edward, had fought in many wars and was tired.
He would not participate in the folly of a competition for an empire he cared nothing for.
Catherine remained childless. She wanted badly to be pregnant and become empress.

There was an uprising by the ministry of Batogol.
War was not done with Edward, and he was to depart for the front line.
Catherine foresaw a long and bleak season of loneliness.

For better or worse she decided to go to the imperial capitol and find a man.

Any man to make her a baby.
